headlines.text: 2024 brought us this moment: FTR & Kingston made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a well-worked match.
2026 brought us this moment: ProtOkada made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.33.
Flash back to 2021, when Thunder Rosa vs. Riho met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 6.06, part of the special USA and Japan Brackets card.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when Ryo Mizunami vs. Yuka Sakazaki met in a Tournament Match on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 7.56 ? a match that delivered, part of the special USA and Japan Brackets card.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Atlantis Jr. wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event against Chris Jericho, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.10.

Flash back to 2024, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Nick Wayne went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.96. It was the first title opportunity of Nick Wayne's career.
